title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E10 — Weird Wednesday
The paramedics and hospital staff deal with a stubborn elderly woman (Jeanette Nolan), a parachutist in a tree and other odd cases.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E11 — Dilemma
Gage and DeSoto rescue an elderly couple from an elevator crash; Brackett berates a forgetful student nurse; a girl irritates Gage.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E12 — Hangup
Gage begins to think a television police show is real; the emergency team at Rampart Hospital treats a doctor for radiation poisoning.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E13 — Crash
Gage and DeSoto rescue a family from the wreck of a private airplane; Early and McCall treat a 4-year-old boy who has swallowed pills.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E21 — The Trouble With Harry
A mobster, avenging his brother's death, stalks an alcoholic ex-boxer; guests Hulk Hogan, William "The Refrigerator" Perry.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E22 — A Little Town With an Accent
A crafty mobster (Mark Lawrence) fakes his own death to avoid prison and plots to take over a town.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E23 — The Sound of Thunder
The search for the half-Vietnamese daughter (Tia Carrere) of Gen. Fulbright leads the team to a resourceful teenager bent on vengeance.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E1 — Dishpan Man
Gen. Stockwell (Robert Vaughn) blackmails the team into rescuing hostages held on board a Mexican airliner by terrorists.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E2 — Trial by Fire
The team faces court-martial in the murder of a colonel who was cooperating with the enemy; guest David Ackroyd.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E3 — Firing Line
Murdock and Frankie Santana ask Gen. Stockwell to help them rescue B.A., Hannibal and Face from a military firing squad.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E4 — Quarterback Sneak
The team joins a touring pro football squad to free an East German scientist; guests Alan Autry, Jim Brown, John Matuszak, Joe Namath.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E5 — The Theory of Revolution
The team must free three CIA agents from a Caribbean prison before an ambitious dictator strikes a deal with the Soviet military.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E6 — The Say Uncle Affair
Stockwell orders the team to steal a Soviet stealth fighter-jet, then is kidnapped by a free-lance spy (David McCallum).
